name: Beloved by the World
body:
You are favored by the spirits of the world and can prepare a small number of spells from other elements that compliment your attuned element.

Prerequisite(s): Wis 13 or higher, ability to cast 1st-level geomancer spells.

Benefit(s): In lieu of preparing a spell from your attuned element whenever you regain your daily geomancer spells, you may instead prepare a spell of equal spell level from a complimentary element to your attuned element. You may only prepare 1 spell for each spell level you are capable of casting in this way. Below are the complimentary elements for each of the five elements.

Earth: complimented by Fire or Metal.
Fire: complimented by Wood or Earth.
Metal: complimented by Earth or Water.
Water: complimented by Metal or Wood.
Wood: complimented by Fire or Water.

Special: If your attuned element is Blood or Void, in lieu of preparing a spell from your attuned element whenever you regain your daily geomancer spells, you may instead prepare a spell of equal level from the divination, runescribing, or universal arcane schools (the spell cannot belong to any one of the 5 elements above). You may only prepare 1 spell for each spell level you are capable of casting in this way.
